name: Kokonoe Maria
source: [url=/c22756]Momoka's[/url] maid and the vice-president of the drama club who likes taking care of people. Just like Momoka, Maria has loved [url=/c22753]Mayu's[/url] acting for a long time. Many think she's not actually a high schooler based on her appearance. Despite this, she is popular with both the students and the teachers due to her kind and friendly personality.
